method: Supabase execute_sql, explicit project, BEGIN READ ONLY / catalog SELECT / ROLLBACK
adaptation: Do not attempt to regrant auth USAGE. Inherit authenticated privileges and assert effective access before creating RPCs.
ownershipTransfer: New-role ADMIN is automatic for CREATEROLE in PostgreSQL 17, but SET is initially false. The explicit self-membership grant enables SET; temporary schema CREATE permits ALTER FUNCTION OWNER and is revoked before commit.

localPermissionRehearsal.environment: Local disposable PostgreSQL; synthetic roles/accounts and explicit Auth/Storage SQL shims. Windows TCP permission required an unsandboxed authorized local test.
localPermissionRehearsal.ownedClusterCleanup: Successful test clusters stopped/removed by harness; interrupted synthetic cluster checked stopped and removed. Unrelated old clusters untouched.

limits: Catalog evidence does not execute DDL in Production. The native permission rehearsal uses explicit Auth/Storage SQL shims; the separate official Supabase stack gate must certify their real HTTP services.
